summary: Kiggans co-sponsored H. Res. 1117 in April 2024 opposing one-sided pressure on Israel with respect to Gaza, voted for H.R. 8034 providing over $26 billion in military aid to Israel, and recorded a Yea on H.R. 6090, the Antisemitism Awareness Act, which directs use of IHRA's definition and examples in Title VI education-discrimination enforcement. These recorded actions place her squarely in the position of shielding Israel.
